name: Skill Optimizer
description: Auto-improve any Claude skill through iterative test-score-refine loops with a live dashboard.
longDescription:
Runs autonomous improvement loops on any skill's `SKILL.md`. Builds a frozen evaluation harness with **anchored 1-5 rubrics** (3-6 criteria, each shown to fail on a weakened variant), then loops up to **15 rounds**: a fresh-context subagent executes the skill against test inputs, another scores the output against the harness, one targeted change is made, keep if improved or revert if not.

Harness is validated and reused across runs when the skill hasn't changed. Includes a self-contained `dashboard.html` with score-over-time chart, per-criterion baseline-vs-current averages, and kept/reverted changelog. Converges automatically at **95%+** on 3 consecutive rounds. Plateau strategy switches approaches (rules → examples → restructuring) after 3 non-improving rounds. Writes the result to `SKILL.improved.md` and leaves the original untouched.
